{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients
n_patients = len(df_dedup)

print(n_patients)"}
